projects.title: Nancy Wilson
projects.subtitle: Fort Worth, Texas
projects.body:
Nancy Wilson is an interdisciplinary artist working in North Texas. They work primarily as an event programmer and art educator, working to eliminate barriers to art in specialized communities.

Nancy will be graduating in winter of 2026 with a BFA in Interdisciplinary Arts and Design from the University of North Texas. She also regularly teaches workshops and coordinates events at the Union Arts Center, a program dedicated to providing consistent arts programming to students of UNT. As a juror with Texas Art Education Association, Nancy has had the priviledge of working directly within communities to assist young adults in developing professional artistic experiences.

projects.title: Speed Bump Fort Worth
projects.subtitle: *caza de arte at La Gran Plaza*
projects.body: caza de arte at La Gran Plaza is an event organized by Nancy Wilson, serving as a larger part of Fort Worth's inaugural Speed Bump art tour. Speed Bump serves as a one-day, completely free art tour highlighting artists and spaces within the city of Fort Worth. This event at La Gran Plaza held the purpose of highlighting the often over looked Gran Plaza, highlighting it's collection of artwork-- and dedicating a large portion of the event to artist Jorge Rodriguez.
